title: fix(app-shell): a personal view opened by its address no longer carries the default view's filter and sort in the URL
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB91foStSJ4BheWaVcVqRJRd)_
Fixes #30034

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：直接打开个人视图时，在「我的视图」读取完成、所请求的视图解析出来之前，列表不再取种子，也不再把任何状态写进地址栏；解析完成后只用该视图自己的状态。
- 为什么改：偏好先到、个人视图后到时，默认视图的筛选和排序会被写进 URL 并留在那里，刷新或分享链接后个人视图带上谁也没选过的条件，还显示「已个性化」。
- 风险与回滚：只改 app-shell 两个文件里的一个门禁（种子条件和写回 effect 的依赖），回滚即还原此 PR；带 `uf_*` 参数的链接行为不变（有对照测试）。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewListUrlState.ts` 的种子条件与 effect 依赖；`ObjectView.tsx` 传入 `awaitingPersonalViews` 的一行；新测试 `ObjectView.personalViews-29635.test.tsx` 末尾的 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.personalViews-29635.test.tsx -t 30034`，预期 3 例全绿；在 main 上同一命令「偏好先到」那例变红，地址栏多出 `uf__filter`/`uf__sort`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- `useObjectViewListUrlState` takes `viewResolving`, which `ObjectView` passes as its existing `awaitingPersonalViews` (a requested or pinned view the list does not hold yet, while the reader's own views are still being read). While it is true, no seed is taken, so the write-back effect has nothing to write: the fall-back view's stored filter, sort and search never reach the address bar. The effect now also lists `viewResolving` in its dependencies, so a resolution that ends on the fall-back view (a pin naming a deleted personal view) still seeds and writes once.
- When the view resolves, the seed is taken for that view alone, by the unchanged rules: the `uf_*` params a link carried, or else the view's own stored state.
- No delay or timer was added. The gate is on the resolved identity.

## Why: the race, measured

The card's reading holds, with the mechanism made concrete. React Router 7's `BrowserRouter` (the Console's router; `MemoryRouter` and `HistoryRouter` too) commits each location change inside `startTransition`. So:

1. The preferences land first. The page is still on the default view (the fall-back while `awaitingPersonalViews`), takes the default view's stored seed and writes it with `setSearchParams` (replace). That location update is a pending transition.
2. The personal views read lands before the transition commits. Its state update is urgent, so React renders it first, against the address as it was before step 1's write.
3. The identity moves to the personal view. Its seed compares against that old, empty address, finds nothing to change, and records the empty key as the page's own write.
4. The transition commits, and the default view's `uf__filter` and `uf__sort` stay in the address bar. The list's own query is the personal view's (its seed was clean), so nothing on screen shows it until a reload or a shared link opens the polluted address.

That matches the card's evidence: the list request carried only the personal view's filter, and reloading the polluted URL drew the filter badge and the personalized marker. On the dev boot below, the pending location update was still not committed when the personal views read landed, about 0.8 s after the write, on every load (6 of 6).

## Tests

New top-level describe in the shared personal-views harness `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.personalViews-29635.test.tsx` (real `ObjectView`, real `ListPreferencesProvider` with an attached family, real router through `unstable_HistoryRouter` over a memory history). The two reads are deferred and land in the order each case names. The address bar is read from the history the router wrote.

- **Personal views read lands AFTER the preferences read** (the personal views read is landed inside the first `history.replace`, which is exactly the window above): the address bar ends with no `uf_*` param, and the list's last query carries the personal view's `Paris` filter and not the default view's `Rome`.
- **The reverse order** (personal views first, then preferences): the same clean end state.
- **CONTROL**: a link carrying `uf__sort` for the personal view keeps that param and the list sorts by it.

<details><summary>Red on main, green on the branch, ablation (head 1cf9cef8)</summary>

- Red on main (`origin/main` blobs of `ObjectView.tsx` and `objectViewListUrlState.ts` checked out over the final test, restored after, `git diff HEAD` empty): `Tests 1 failed | 2 passed`. The failing case is the AFTER order; received `uf__filter` = the default view's `city equals Rome` and `uf__sort` = `status desc`.
- Mechanism probe on main: the same test with `useTransitions={false}` on the router passes all 3. The red is the transition window, not some other write.
- Ablation (fix committed first, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` removing `!viewResolving &&` from the seed condition, restored blob == HEAD): `Tests 1 failed | 2 passed`, the same AFTER case red.
- Branch: the harness file `Tests 14 passed (14)`. The 88 app-shell test files that import `ObjectView` or `objectViewListUrlState`: `Test Files 88 passed (88)`, `Tests 833 passed (833)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (both tsconfigs): exit 0. `npx eslint` on the 3 changed files from the package dir: 0 errors (80 existing `react-hooks/refs` warnings, none new in kind).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Acceptance 1 and 2 are pinned by the two order cases, and acceptance 4 by the CONTROL. Acceptance 3 ("every load") was measured live: 0 of 6 loads polluted after the fix, against 6 of 6 before (Verification).
- The gate also covers a pinned personal view opened from the bare address, since `awaitingPersonalViews` already includes the pin arm.
- `listIdentityKey` itself still names the fall-back view while resolving. Nothing renders the list then (`ObjectView` draws no list while `awaitingPersonalViews`), and the chip selections are re-read per identity, so only the seed needed the gate.

## Verification

<details><summary>Local gates at head 1cf9cef8: 35 derived, 35 exit 0</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at `1cf9cef8` (merge base `c23501b2b`, 4 paths): 35 families, each run serially. All 35 exited 0, including `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` and its `--self-test`, `pnpm check:type-check-debt` (it took the verify lock for its own build), and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (run under the lock).
- `--ran` reconciliation exit 0: 35 derived, 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- CI families: this pull's check-runs had not concluded when it was opened. The seat cites them at ACCEPT.

</details>

<details><summary>Live check on a dev boot: 6 of 6 loads polluted before, 0 of 6 after</summary>

- Stack: full `turbo run build --filter='!@objectstack/docs'` under the lock (exit 0), the showcase boot `pnpm dev -- --fresh -p 4317`, and the Console's vite from `ui/apps/console` serving ui src. Vite was restarted between legs with `--force`: in this container it did not pick up a src change made under a running server.
- Seeded by API as the admin: a writable package, an object with 3 rows, its default list view `pvrace_item.default`, an app, the admin's stored list state for the default view (`city equals Rome`, `status desc`, in `sys_user_preference` key `ui.list.pvrace_item`), and one personal view filtered to `city equals Paris`.
- CONTROL, both legs: the bare default view address restores the stored state into the address bar (`uf__filter` Rome + `uf__sort` status desc). So the stored state was there to leak.
- Before (`origin/main` src of both files): 6 hard loads of `/apps/com.qa.pvrace/pvrace_item/view/PV_ID`. All 6 ended with the default view's `uf__filter` and `uf__sort` in the address bar. In a traced main load, the list's request carried only the personal view's `city equals Paris`, as the card measured.
- After (head `1cf9cef8` src): the same 6 loads all ended with no `uf_*` param.
- The boot and vite were torn down (health 000).

</details>
